entities.name: Great War
entities.description: The conflict between the Ancients and the Tolgath, also known as the Wizards' Wars.

entities.name: Ancients
entities.description: One side of the Great War.

entities.name: Tolgath
entities.description: The other side of the Great War.

entities.name: Great Destruction
entities.description: Battle on Ulgrotha in which the Great War culminated.

entities.name: Ravi
entities.description: Young Tolgath who rang the Apocalypse Chime and created the Dead Zone.

entities.name: Apocalypse Chime
entities.description: Chime whose ringing created the Dead Zone.

entities.name: Dead Zone
entities.description: Zone created by the chime that killed nearly every creature and destroyed the world's mana lines.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: Plane whose spiritual and physical realms were destabilized by the war.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War on Kamigawa indirectly caused by the Great War.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane whose Talon Gates were connected to other worlds.

events.summary: The Great War ends when Ravi rings the Apocalypse Chime without knowing its effects, creating the Dead Zone.
events.quote: The war ended when the young Tolgath Ravi rang the Apocalypse Chime

events.summary: The rifts of the war disturb the stability between Kamigawa's spiritual and physical realms, leading indirectly to the Kami War.
events.quote: leading indirectly to the Kami War

relations.note: Opposed sides in the Great War.
relations.quote: the conflict between the Ancients and the Tolgath

relations.note: Created it by ringing the chime.
